payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Delisa, Gerda, Mackenzie, Maya, Raylene, Tonya

payload.content: Planning: Raylene here (8h avail, backend skill 0.85). I strongly prefer ISSUE-0002 tasks (mobile-development, backend). My lowest cost is ISSUE-0002::review (1.90) then test (2.66) then implement (3.80). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks (very high cost). Looking to coordinate so no duplicates; please pick different ISSUE-0002 micro-tasks if you’re claiming any.

Planning update (Delisa): I have strong api-development skill (0.83) and low cost only on ISSUE-0001 tasks; ISSUE-0002 costs are very high (review/test/implement). I prefer to claim one of ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage to avoid duplicates and keep cost low. Share what you’re taking on ISSUE-0001/0002 so we avoid collision.

Delisa proposal: I can take ISSUE-0001::review (effort 1.0, low priority) at cost 1.94, or ISSUE-0001::docs/triage similarly cost 1.94. If others want those, tell me quickly; otherwise I’ll pick the first available.

Planning (Mackenzie): mobile-development skill moderate (0.62). I see my costs: ISSUE-0002::review 2.44, test 3.42, implement 4.88; ISSUE-0001 tasks all very high cost. To avoid duplicates with Raylene (likely taking ISSUE-0002::review), I can take ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4, priority medium) or implement if needed. I’m leaning ISSUE-0002::test.

Planning: Tonya here. I’m strongest in infrastructure (0.82) and my lowest costs are ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage (~1.95) then test (2.73). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 implement (3.91) and all ISSUE-0002 tasks (very high cost). To avoid duplicates with Delisa, please confirm who’s taking ISSUE-0001::review and/or docs/triage; I can take whichever remains (likely triage).
Tonya offer: I’m likely to claim ISSUE-0001::triage if not taken. If review/docs/triage already covered, I’ll skip to avoid duplicates.

Planning update (Maya): my skill match is better for ISSUE-0002 (mobile/api) but private costs show lowest for ISSUE-0002::review (2.06). I can take ISSUE-0002::review if others avoid duplicates; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage but costs are higher. Please confirm your intended picks for ISSUE-0002::review/test/implement and ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage so we don’t collide.

If Raylene claims ISSUE-0002::review and Mackenzie claims ISSUE-0002::test, I’m likely to take ISSUE-0002::implement (only remaining backend) in execution. If implement is claimed, I’ll skip to avoid duplicate.

Gerda planning: I’m backend-focused but my private costs make ISSUE-0001 prohibitively expensive (>=10). I also can do ISSUE-0002 but cheapest is review=2.18; implement/test are costly (4.37/3.06) and my 5h availability suggests review is best. I’ll target ISSUE-0002::review IF not already taken; otherwise I’ll skip or take remaining low-effort option to avoid duplicate.

Raylene planning confirmation: I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution (lowest cost for me: 1.90). I will avoid any other tasks and won’t take ISSUE-0001. Please ensure nobody else picks ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplicates.

Planning: I (Delisa) will take ISSUE-0001::docs (effort 1.0, low, cost 1.94) unless someone else already has it. Goal: avoid duplicates with Tonya likely taking triage and others focusing on ISSUE-0002::review/test.
Delisa clarification: In execution I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs (not review/triage/test). Please do not pick ISSUE-0001::docs.
Mackenzie planning update: to avoid duplicates with Raylene (likely ISSUE-0002::review), I will take ISSUE-0002::test in execution. I will not claim any ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high cost.

Planning status: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage in execution ONLY if ISSUE-0001::triage is still unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip. Confirm that Delisa has ISSUE-0001::docs and that Raylene has ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie ISSUE-0002::test.

Maya planning: Based on confirmations (Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test, Delisa=ISSUE-0001::docs), I will target ISSUE-0002::implement in execution (backend) if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates. Please confirm nobody else will take ISSUE-0002::implement.

Gerda planning: Given Raylene plans ISSUE-0002::review, and Mackenzie ISSUE-0002::test, Delisa ISSUE-0001::docs, I will avoid duplicates. If ISSUE-0002::review remains unclaimed in execution, I can take it; otherwise I’ll skip (and won’t touch ISSUE-0001 tasks due to high cost).

Raylene planning: confirming I will take ISSUE-0002::review (priority=medium) in execution; please do NOT claim ISSUE-0002::review. I will only take this single task and skip others. (phase=planning, iter=1)
Delisa (planning): confirming I will take ISSUE-0001::docs in execution. I will not take ISSUE-0001::review/triage/test or any ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please avoid ISSUE-0001::docs duplicates.

Mackenzie planning: confirm I will take ISSUE-0002::test (medium) in execution; I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks due to high costs and will not take ISSUE-0002::review to prevent duplicates. Please coordinate ISSUE-0002::implement among remaining agents if unclaimed.

Tonya planning: confirming I will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks (too high cost). I will take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution ONLY if unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. Delisa already has ISSUE-0001::docs and Raylene has ISSUE-0002::review; Mackenzie has ISSUE-0002::test.

Maya planning: already coordinated that Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test, Delisa=ISSUE-0001::docs. I will claim ISSUE-0002::implement in execution if unclaimed; otherwise skip to avoid duplicates.

Gerda planning: based on confirmed picks (Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test, Delisa=ISSUE-0001::docs), I will avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0002::review and won’t touch ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high cost. In execution I will likely skip unless those assumptions change; otherwise can take nothing.

Raylene planning (confirm): I will take ISSUE-0002::review in execution. Please do NOT claim ISSUE-0002::review; let others take ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::implement or ISSUE-0001::docs/triage. I will only do this single task.
Delisa (planning): Confirming I will claim ISSUE-0001::docs in execution. I will NOT take ISSUE-0001::review/triage/test nor any ISSUE-0002 tasks. Please avoid ISSUE-0001::docs duplicates.

Planning update (Mackenzie): confirming I will NOT take ISSUE-0002::review (Raylene). I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::test in execution (effort 1.4, medium). I will avoid all ISSUE-0001 due to very high cost; please ensure no one else takes ISSUE-0002::test to prevent duplicates.

Tonya planning status: Delisa=ISSUE-0001::docs, Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test. I will take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip to avoid duplicates. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks and ISSUE-0001::review/docs.

Planning complete: Maya will take ISSUE-0002::implement in execution if unclaimed; otherwise skip. Confirmed others: Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test, Delisa=ISSUE-0001::docs, Tonya=ISSUE-0001::triage if unclaimed.

Gerda planning: since Raylene=ISSUE-0002::review, Mackenzie=ISSUE-0002::test, Delisa=ISSUE-0001::docs, Tonya=ISSUE-0001::triage (if unclaimed), I will avoid duplicates on ISSUE-0002::review/test and avoid all ISSUE-0001 due to high cost. I plan to skip in execution unless a claimed task unexpectedly becomes unassigned.
